hypotheses.title: Put Option Downside Volatility Premium and Cash Balance Buffer
hypotheses.economic_rationale: One-year put implied volatility (implied_volatility_put_360) reflects the structural premium institutions pay to hedge against equity market crashes. When normalized by trailing 90-day realized high-low volatility (parkinson_volatility_90), it isolates equities where downside hedging demand is abnormally high relative to actual volatility. Pairing this with balance sheet cash liquidity (cash_st / assets) and short-term price reversal extracts the uncrowded put variance risk premium while hedging out systematic equity beta.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail to outperform when put implied volatility flattens to parity with Parkinson volatility.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_put_360 / parkinson_volatility_90, 60), sector) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(cash_st, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), sector) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, sector)

hypotheses.title: Analyst Consensus Median EPS Yield and Capex Reinvestment Rate
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Analyst consensus median EPS estimates (anl4_afv4_median_eps) provide an unpolluted gauge of forward operational earnings capacity. Ranking the forward earnings yield over the equity's 180-day historical distribution captures stocks trading at cyclically high earnings yields. Stabilizing with capital expenditure reinvestment intensity (anl4_capex_value / assets) selects capital-disciplined firms that compound organic shareholder value.
confounders: Analyst herd behavior and delayed forecast downgrades
Cyclical Capex peaks prior to economic downturns
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha Sharpe decays below 0.8 during macroeconomic recessions with widespread earnings downgrades.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_median_eps, 60) / close, 180), sector) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(anl4_capex_value, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), sector) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, sector)

hypotheses.title: Book-to-Price Value Convexity and Balance Sheet Cash Solvency
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Book value per share (bookvalue_ps) scaled by price isolates traditional Fama-French value. Ranking book yield against its own 180-day historical range identifies temporarily depressed compounders. Backing the valuation signal with balance sheet cash and short-term liquid investments (cash_st / assets) prevents value traps by ensuring solvency resilience and debt service capability.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms during speculative growth regimes where unpriced intangibles dominate balance sheets.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(bookvalue_ps, 60) / close, 180), sector) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(cash_st, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), sector) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, sector)
